item.title: Iran eyes bigger share of China’s growing copper market
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s commercial attaché in Shanghai has stressed the need to expand exports of high-value-added copper products and tap into China’s growing market for copper derivatives.

item.title: Pezeshkian orders probe into fatal fuel tanker explosion in western Iran

item.title: In photos: Int’l congresses on stem cells and biomedicine held in Iran
item.description: The “27th Reproductive Biomedicine” and the “22nd Congress on Stem Cell Biology and Technology,” organized by the Royan Institute, were held in Tehran on September 2, 2026.
